objective.name: request
objective.description: Provider-agnostic contract of an inference request addressed to this LLM context.

functional._messages_comment: Ordered array of already-prepared messages forming the inference input. Each message carries a role and content. The LLM context receives the cognitive input already prepared. A message may carry cache: true, a provider-neutral hint that it ends a stable prefix reused across inferences; a provider without explicit caching ignores it.
functional._metadata_comment: Optional free object describing the request for whoever observes it (for example the continuity and the step that asked). No provider adapter reads it: it is never sent to a provider.

parameters._temperature_comment: Optional generation temperature when supported by the resolved model.
parameters._top_p_comment: Optional nucleus-sampling parameter when supported by the resolved model.
parameters._max_output_tokens_comment: Optional maximum number of tokens requested for the generated output.

requirements._provider_comment: Optional provider constraint. When absent, any compatible provider may be resolved.
requirements._model_comment: Optional explicit model constraint. When absent, an appropriate model may be resolved.
requirements._capabilities_comment: Optional characteristics required from the model and used during model resolution.
requirements._reasoning_comment: Optional requested reasoning characteristic or level, translated by the provider adapter when supported.

output._format_comment: Requested representation of the generated output.
output._schema_comment: Optional structured-output contract when constrained structured generation is required.
